title: Impact kernel reference entry
responsibility: Validates requests and exposes the TypeScript reference impact calculation through values or JSON text.

inputs.name: impactKernel.request
inputs.description: Unknown request to check for portable JSON before operation dispatch.

inputs.name: impactKernelPortable.request
inputs.description: Request whose portable JSON admission has already been established by the caller.

inputs.name: impactKernelText.text
inputs.description: Raw JSON request text to parse and pass through the normal kernel entry.

outputs.name: impactKernel
outputs.description: Success containing the contract version or affected-node calculation, or a structured invalid-json, invalid-request, unknown-operation or invalid-graph failure.

outputs.name: impactKernelPortable
outputs.description: Same operation result without repeating portable JSON admission; supports version and impact only.

outputs.name: impactKernelText
outputs.description: JSON-serialized runtime response; malformed JSON text is serialized as invalid-json failure.
